about: The service accounts of the project on the network named above: the accounts that open, fund or pay jobs and rewards. It does not list every funded account of the genesis file. A client address in a job listing that is not on this list belongs to someone else. Every address written in the published code is listed here or is a named test vector. A new genesis needs a new list.

accounts.name: generator
accounts.description: Opens the requests of the Final Testnet Season programme and pays their fees. Every job it opens carries this address as its client.
accounts.read_with: GET /final-season/v1/status on the testnet API, field generator.

accounts.name: gateway
accounts.description: Signs the jobs that the public chat gateway opens on the free tier. Its balance comes from the faucet account.
accounts.read_with: The client field of the jobs the chat gateway opens (GET /rest/dendra/jobs/v1/job). The proof service counts them with DENDRA_PROOF_GATEWAY_ADDRESS (the_proof.py::origin_partition).

accounts.name: faucet
accounts.description: Signs the faucet drips. At launch it also seeds the gateway account once (launch_public.sh, step 7b). One key holds both roles.
accounts.read_with: The sender of the drips: the node RPC tx_search with the query transfer.sender equal to this address. The genesis file credits the faucet float to this account.

accounts.name: season-payer
accounts.description: Pays the Final Testnet Season rewards. Each week is paid in one or more transactions, each with many transfers; the memo of each transaction starts with dendra-final-season-week.
accounts.read_with: The node RPC tx_search with the query message.sender equal to this address. The memos are built by final_season_payout.py::memo.

protocol_accounts.name: emission-reserve
protocol_accounts.description: Holds the emission reserve. The address is derived from the module name, so no key controls it.
protocol_accounts.read_with: entrypoint-chain.sh derives the address from the module name emission and stops the boot when it differs from the pinned one.
